page.overview:
What is Kaladesh Inventions?

Kaladesh Inventions is a promotional Magic set of 54 foil artifact cards that are randomly inserted in boosters of the Kaladesh block. The set is part of the Masterpiece Series.

Cards of this set feature a special Kaladesh-Inspired card frame and a separate expansion symbol. Thus, they are not part of the sets themselves. Kaladesh Inventions feature all new art set on Kaladesh and appear slightly more often than premium mythic rares. They are printed in English only, but can be opened in packs of all languages. These cards are playable in limited and formats where they're already legal. 30 Invention cards appear with Kaladesh and 24 more cards in Aether Revolt.

Kaladesh Inventions did not appear in Magic Duels. They were collectable on Magic Online as Curated Cards, which were not redeemable.
